## The defaults file

```yaml
# The defaults of every option of .github/davils-ci.yaml. A repository only writes what differs.
#
# Precedence, lowest first: these defaults, the preset, .github/davils-ci.yaml, the `config` input
# of pipeline.yml, the typed inputs of pipeline.yml. Mappings merge key by key, lists replace.
#
# Toggles take true, false or auto. auto turns a feature on when the repository has what it needs:
# a Dart package for dart, a writerside.cfg for writerside, an app for the Flutter builds.
#
# Every feature has `when`: the events it runs on (push is a branch push, tag a tag push), the
# branches (globs, for push events; empty means all) and the paths (globs relative to the working
# directory, for pull_request, merge_group and push events; empty means any change).
version: 1

project:
  working-directory: .
  release-branch: main
  integration-branch: develop

packages:
  include: []
  exclude: []
  external-path-dependencies: error
  affected-only: auto
  always-all-paths:
    - pubspec.yaml
    - pubspec.lock
    - analysis_options.yaml
    - dart_test.yaml
    - inspectra.yaml
    - inspectra.base.yaml
    - trivy*.yaml
    - tool/**
    - .github/**
  granularity: auto
  shards: 8
  shard-threshold: 20

dart:
  enabled: auto
  sdks: [stable, lowest]
  os: [ubuntu]
  format:
    enabled: true
    command: ''
  analyze:
    enabled: true
    fatal-infos: true
    command: ''
  test:
    enabled: true
    platforms: []
    other-os-platforms: []
    command: ''
    args: ''
    report: false
  coverage:
    enabled: true
    source: auto
    min: 0
    codecov: false
  build-runner:
    enabled: auto
    command: ''
  verify:
    command: ''
  publish-dry-run:
    enabled: auto
  pana:
    enabled: false
    min-points: 0
  downgrade:
    enabled: false
  when:
    events: [push, pull_request, merge_group, schedule, workflow_dispatch]
    branches: []
    paths: []

flutter:
  enabled: auto
  channel: stable
  versions: [stable]
  version-file: ''
  os: [ubuntu]
  format:
    enabled: true
    command: ''
  analyze:
    enabled: true
    fatal-infos: true
    command: ''
  test:
    enabled: true
    command: ''
    args: ''
    exclude-tags: ''
    report: false
  coverage:
    enabled: true
    source: auto
    min: 0
    codecov: false
  build-runner:
    enabled: auto
    command: ''
  verify:
    command: ''
  publish-dry-run:
    enabled: auto
  golden:
    enabled: false
    os: macos
    tags: golden
  integration-test:
    enabled: false
    device: auto
  l10n:
    enabled: auto
  when:
    events: [push, pull_request, merge_group, schedule, workflow_dispatch]
    branches: []
    paths: []

inspectra:
  enabled: auto
  install: auto
  version: latest
  config-file: ''
  profile: ''
  check:
    enabled: true
    root: auto
  scan:
    enabled: true
    recursive: true
    fail-on: high
    min-severity: ''
  sarif:
    enabled: auto
    category: inspectra
  summary:
    enabled: true
  report:
    enabled: auto
  config-lint:
    enabled: true
  config-diff:
    enabled: auto
  trivy:
    mode: ''
    version: ''
    cache: true
  offline: false
  tolerate-incomplete: false
  when:
    events: [push, pull_request, merge_group, schedule, workflow_dispatch]
    branches: []
    paths: []

writerside:
  enabled: auto
  instances: []
  builder: docker
  builder-image: jetbrains/writerside-builder
  builder-version: '2026.09.0357'
  checker:
    enabled: true
  pdf: ''
  algolia:
    enabled: false
    app-name: ''
    index: ''
  when:
    events: [push, pull_request, merge_group, workflow_dispatch]
    branches: []
    paths: []

dartdoc:
  enabled: auto
  publishable-only: true
  validate-links: true
  fail-on-warnings: false
  dry-run-on-pr: true
  args: ''
  when:
    events: [push, pull_request, merge_group, workflow_dispatch]
    branches: []
    paths: []

pages:
  enabled: auto
  deploy: true
  parts:
    docs: true
    api: true
    web: true
    coverage: false
    inspectra: false
  layout:
    docs: /
    api: /api
    web: /app/{id}
    coverage: /coverage/{id}
    inspectra: /quality
  landing-page: auto
  cname: ''
  spa-fallback: ''
  extra-path: ''
  environment: github-pages
  when:
    events: [push, workflow_dispatch]
    branches: [main]
    paths: []

build:
  flutter:
    enabled: auto
    apps: []
    targets:
      web: auto
      apk: false
      appbundle: false
      ios: false
      ipa: false
      macos: false
      linux-x64: false
      linux-arm64: false
      windows-x64: false
      windows-arm64: false
    build-mode: release
    flavor: ''
    target-file: ''
    dart-define-from-file: ''
    extra-args: ''
    build-name: pubspec
    build-number: run-number
    obfuscate: false
    web-wasm: false
    android-signing: auto
    apple-signing: auto
    macos-notarize: false
    java-version: '17'
    environment: ''
    when:
      events: [push, workflow_dispatch]
      branches: [main]
      paths: []
  dart-compile:
    enabled: auto
    executables: []
    targets: [linux-x64, linux-arm64, macos-arm64, macos-x64, windows-x64]
    archive: zip
    checksums: true
    smoke-test-args: --version
    when:
      events: [push, workflow_dispatch]
      branches: [main]
      paths: []

release:
  mode: auto
  tag-patterns:
    single: v{version}
    package: '{package}-v{version}'
  verify:
    enabled: true
    on-branch: main
  pub:
    enabled: auto
    environment: pub.dev
    wait-for-siblings: true
    wait-attempts: 60
    wait-interval: 30
  github:
    enabled: true
    notes-source: auto
    attest: true
    checksums: true
    draft: false
    make-latest: auto
  release-please:
    token-source: app
    config-file: release-please-config.json
    manifest-file: .release-please-manifest.json
    dispatch-workflow: ''
    back-merge: false

pr:
  title:
    enabled: true
    types: []
    scopes: []
    require-scope: false
    subject-pattern: ''
  branch-policy:
    enabled: true
    main-allowed-sources: [develop, release-please--*, hotfix/*]
  when:
    events: [pull_request]
    branches: []
    paths: []

security:
  harden-runner:
    enabled: true
    egress-policy: audit
    allowed-endpoints: ''

hooks:
  pre-setup: ''
  post-setup: ''
  pre-test: ''
  post-test: ''
  pre-publish: ''

runners:
  linux: ubuntu-latest
  linux-arm: ubuntu-24.04-arm
  macos: macos-latest
  macos-intel: macos-15-intel
  windows: windows-latest
  windows-arm: windows-11-arm

timeouts:
  ci: 45
  inspectra: 30
  docs: 20
  build: 60
  publish: 45
  release: 20

artifacts:
  retention-days: 7
```
